proposed_new_assessments.route: CP5V / CDC20 degradation and early meiotic resumption
proposed_new_assessments.disposition: Retain defect-specific early meiotic-resumption comparator; no drug-treated fidelity or MVA rescue established
proposed_new_assessments.rationale: The 5 µM CDC20-directed PROTAC improves early germinal-vesicle breakdown after Ccdc41 depletion and reverses CDC20/Cyclin B1 changes, with drug-treated normal controls present. This linked degrader is distinct from Apcin. No drug-specific euploidy, fertility, productive lineage or muscle outcome is supplied. Exact pretreatment timing and functional-arm denominators remain limited.
proposed_new_assessments.evidence_scope: One ex vivo mouse-oocyte primary with Ccdc41 morpholino depletion; native treatment/normal-control panels and limitations qualified. Root full-main reading attributed separately from bounded independent check.

proposed_new_assessments.route: CA-074 / cathepsin-B inhibition in CCDC41-deficient oocytes
proposed_new_assessments.disposition: Retain partial spindle/checkpoint/timing rescue comparator; no normal-drug-control or MVA efficacy established
proposed_new_assessments.rationale: At 1 µM, CA-074 reduces abnormal spindle fraction and premature MII and raises MAD1/CREST after Ccdc41 depletion. Timing and MAD1 remain different from control; APC2 is unchanged. No normal drug-treated arm, drug aneuploidy result or BUBR1 restoration assay is supplied. Source HY-103350 identifies CA-074 rather than its methyl ester. Panel lettering and timing discrepancies remain explicit.
proposed_new_assessments.evidence_scope: One ex vivo mouse-oocyte primary with Ccdc41 morpholino depletion; native treatment/normal-control panels and limitations qualified. Root full-main reading attributed separately from bounded independent check.

proposed_new_assessments.route: Concanamycin A / V-ATPase inhibition and meiotic timing
proposed_new_assessments.disposition: Retain restricted timing/marker positive with normal-progression inhibition; no demonstrated spindle-width or MVA rescue
proposed_new_assessments.rationale: At 115 nM, Concanamycin A reduces premature MII in Ccdc41-depleted oocytes with Cyclin B1/CDC20 and acidification-marker changes. Native S7 labels chromosome-width improvement and APC2 change nonsignificant despite stronger prose. Drug-treated normal controls show near-zero MII at the observed early time. This is Concanamycin, not Concanavalin A; no drug-treated euploidy, fertility or BUBR1 assay establishes faithful rescue.
proposed_new_assessments.evidence_scope: One ex vivo mouse-oocyte primary with Ccdc41 morpholino depletion; native treatment/normal-control panels and limitations qualified. Root full-main reading attributed separately from bounded independent check.

prior_object.evidence_scope: Partial kinetochore primary sections and separately reviewed full rat-muscle primary paper; intervention-specific endpoints and source limits retained.
prior_object.rationale: 10micromolar MG132 improves alignment after nocodazole withdrawal in CENP50-deficient chicken cells, but persistent mitosis after drug removal prevents calling it completed fidelity rescue. That source has partial primary-text access and unavailable figure-specific n. Separate primary rat-muscle experiments establish ex vivo anti-proteolysis benefit, not contractile force, systemic treatment or BUB1B rescue. Preserve these positive biochemical endpoints without assigning them to bortezomib or an approved human regimen. Direct synthesis/balance and washout figures in the muscle paper used LLN, not MG132. In [Orr, PMID 27829147](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27829147/) MG132 appears only as arrest machinery: 5 micromolar throughout every photoactivation experiment to prevent mitotic exit, and 5 micromolar for 4 hr to enrich the mitotic population for a western. It therefore bounds every k-MT half-life number in that paper and adds no MG132 benefit or harm. Recorded because the alias rule lands the record on this entry; disposition unchanged.

proposed_object.rationale: 10micromolar MG132 improves alignment after nocodazole withdrawal in CENP50-deficient chicken cells, but persistent mitosis after drug removal prevents calling it completed fidelity rescue. That source has partial primary-text access and unavailable figure-specific n. Separate primary rat-muscle experiments establish ex vivo anti-proteolysis benefit, not contractile force, systemic treatment or BUB1B rescue. Preserve these positive biochemical endpoints without assigning them to bortezomib or an approved human regimen. Direct synthesis/balance and washout figures in the muscle paper used LLN, not MG132. In [Orr, PMID 27829147](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27829147/) MG132 appears only as arrest machinery: 5 micromolar throughout every photoactivation experiment to prevent mitotic exit, and 5 micromolar for 4 hr to enrich the mitotic population for a western. It therefore bounds every k-MT half-life number in that paper and adds no MG132 benefit or harm. Recorded because the alias rule lands the record on this entry; disposition unchanged. A separate CCDC41-depleted mouse-oocyte study (PMID41331237) adds actual10µM MG132 partial phenotype protection: lower earlyMII and chromosome-region width.
